notes.title: Waking is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

The time has finally come, Waking, Jason Oda and tinyBuild's introspective action adventure 5 years in the making, is out now!

Battle the forces of darkness. Conjure memories of your loved ones. Join them in the fight for your future.

Waking has been a labour of love for over five years, and to celebrate this moment, when you all get to experience Waking yourselves, we are delighted to share with you the Waking Launch Trailer. Take a look:

[previewyoutube=sK0oJLmIJ0M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your enthusiasm and support of Waking, we hope you enjoy your time with it.

If you do, please be sure to leave a review [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]right here[/url] on the game's Steam page! The more positive reviews Waking has, the more people will find our game and get to experience it for themselves. Your positive reviews would be appreciated more than we could ever express.

Thank you again, and see you in the Mindscape...

notes.title: Waking launch day livestream and developer Q+A!
notes.content:
Hello again friends,

We are delighted to say that on June 18th (that's launch day!) we'll be streaming Waking live with the developer Jason Oda for the Steam Game Festival!

Our meditative, emotional action/adventure is fast approaching, launching on June 18th, so we thought this would be a perfect opportunity to show off some never-before-seen live gameplay from Waking, right here on the Steam page, all while answering your questions about the game!

We'll be discussing the game's systems, the meditation features, and answering any questions about Waking from you in our stream chat Q+A, right here on the Waking Steam page.

The livestream will take place on June 18th at 9pm CEST / 12pm PT / 3pm ET / 8pm BST right here on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]Waking Steam page[/url].

Be sure to set a reminder! ⏰

Date: June 18th 2020
Time: 9pm CEST / 12pm PT / 3pm ET / 8pm BST
Where: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]Waking Steam page[/url]

We can't wait to hang out with you in the chat!

Thank you, and stay safe.

notes.title: Celebrate launch week with us at the Steam Game Festival, starting today!
notes.content:
Hey friends, 

As Waking fast approaches its release on Thursday June 18th, we are excited to announce that Waking will be taking part in the Steam Game Festival...which starts right now! 

That's right, we're joining the festivities with a gameplay live stream, a developer Q+A, a brand new trailer, and a comprehensive demo of Waking for you all to enjoy. The action kicks off today with a free extensive demo of Waking, available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]right here[/url] from June 16th - June 22nd. 

If you are new to Waking, here's an intro to our meditative, introspective action/adventure:

[i]Locked in the darkness of a coma, you dream. In the recesses of your mind, voices call you home, beckoning you towards the light and the void beyond. But it is not your time. Not yet. 

Waking is a uniquely personal journey of self-reflection and remembrance combining third-person exploration and real-world meditation. Traverse the twisted pathways of your mind in a quest to wake, and make choices that shape a uniquely individual experience. Along the way, face your fears and desires as you summon memories of loved ones, and do battle with those who would have you sleep forever.[/i] 

To find out more about Waking with a Q+A with developer Jason Oda, and check out some never-before-seen gameplay, be sure to drop in on our Steam Game Festival launch day livestream on June 18th at 12pm PT / 3pm ET / 9pm CEST / 8pm BST right here on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]Waking Steam page[/url]. Remember to mark it in your calendars!

We are so excited to be a part of the Steam Game Festival, and we hope you'll join us this week to celebrate wonderful video games and Waking's June 18th launch! 

Lastly, if you are interested in our unique meditative action adventure, please do [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068600/Waking/]Wishlist Waking[/url] on Steam today, it really helps support the work we do in crafting a game like this. 

Thank you, stay safe.

notes.title: Waking Releases June 18th!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

It’s time to finally share some very exciting news that’s been over five years in the making. That’s right, Waking has an official release date!

We are proud to announce that you’ll be able to reunite with your loved ones through guided meditations and fast-flowing action in Waking on PC and Xbox One this 18th June.

To celebrate the release date announcement, we thought this would be a perfect opportunity to reveal a new trailer featuring brand new gameplay. Be sure to check it out below:

https://www.youtube.com/embed/UXuiDsW7fsU

That’s enough excitement for one day, but please do stay tuned as we’ll have a bunch of exciting new updates for you in the run-up to Waking’s launch on 18th June.

Of course, it would help us immensely if you could wishlist Waking on Steam, or follow us over on Twitter for more regular updates, gifs, videos, and to interact with us. Either way we are grateful for your support and we hope you are as excited for the launch of Waking as we are.

Stay safe,

Jason Oda and the tinyBuild team.
